caption:
Global Metadata:
Basic Attributes: bpm is 88, bright but cool major tonality. Icy Toybox Instrumental / Gentle Ambient Folk, drawing on a soft bell and mallet palette (glockenspiel, marimba, airy pad) with a calm, spacious sense of melody.
Global Emotional Progression: The piece opens hushed and sparkling, like frost catching morning light. It settles into a calm, glassy, evenly gentle energy — slower and more spacious than a typical upbeat piece — with no dramatic peak and no anxious dip, then fades in the outro to one soft chime, like snow quietly settling.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: A tactile felt-and-cardstock papercraft icy sea on a sunlit tabletop; a small child's finger tracing a paper map across a gentle glacier and calm polar water; a cozy, safe stillness, never lonely or frightening.
Sonics & Production Profile: Airy and spacious but still close-feeling, with a gentle soft low end and sparkling clean highs from the bell tones. Extra headroom and breathing room between notes compared to a busier track. Consistent, quiet, even loudness throughout with no sudden dynamic jumps.

Vocal Details:
Fully instrumental. No vocals, no singing, no vocalizing, no spoken words anywhere in the track. The lead melodic role is carried by a bright, bell-like glockenspiel, answered and doubled by soft marimba.

Arrangement:
Instrument Lifecycle (Primary/Secondary): Primary: a bright, bell-like glockenspiel carries the main tune from the first bar to the last, played slowly and sparsely. Secondary: soft marimba enters in the intro to double and answer the melody; a gentle sustained airy pad underlays from the first instrumental section; very light hand percussion (a softly brushed frame drum, never struck hard) enters sparingly and unhurried.
Groove & Foundation Progression: Percussion stays minimal and unhurried throughout — soft brushed texture rather than a driving pulse. The energy stays consistently calm and spacious across all instrumental sections with no build-up, drop, or breakdown; the outro thins to one bell note fading into silence.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: A soft wind-chime sparkle marks the transition into each instrumental section. Gentle room ambience with extra spaciousness, no reverb swells, no risers, no sweeps — nothing loud or sudden, safe and soothing for a preschool-aged listener on a tablet speaker.
